question: Does the published NIDS-Net and SAM-6D local patch appearance score reject context-bearing distractors and localize all three consumed D15 query views on the fixed 40% tile roster?

predecessor.single_change: Replace hand-built aspect conditioning with the published NIDS local appearance score: select the best template by max FFA, average each query foreground patch's maximum cosine to that template's foreground patches, and average this local score with max FFA.

descriptor.instance_feature: SAM-mask-weighted mean of normalized DINOv2 patch tokens, identical to predecessor FFA.

memory.template_selection: Maximum target-reference FFA cosine with lexical key tie break.

appearance.query_to_template_score: For every binary-masked query patch, take maximum cosine to all binary-masked patches of the best FFA template; average across query patches and clamp to [0,1].
appearance.fusion: Arithmetic mean of maximum target-reference FFA cosine and query-to-template local appearance score.

evaluation.truth_role: Provider truth enters only post-ranking opportunity and refined IoU evaluation.

literature_motivation.official_code_contract: src/model/dinov2.py thresholds pooled mask patches at >0.5; src/model/detector.py computes query-directed patch max-then-mean and averages it with the instance score.

forbidden_after_freeze: change tile geometry, proposal caps, prompt, thresholds, patch direction, template selection, score fusion, SAM or IoU gate
use query truth, sibling appearance, aspect ratio or image position in ranking
claim consumed D15 evidence as fresh confirmation
empty_mask_contract: A proposal without positive weighted or >0.5 binary foreground patch support cannot form the frozen representation; skip it deterministically and report the count.
claim_boundary: This consumed D15 Development run can establish only whether the published local appearance score repairs the observed context-bearing ranking failure on the frozen multiscale roster. It cannot regain fresh authority or establish open-set rejection, provider independence, raw-phone operation, named entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety.
